purpose: Input schema the sealed B0 scorer enforces. Units are fixed by the vendor export documentation, never inferred from similarity to the 174-subject reference.

layout.discovery: recursively glob '*activity*.csv' and '*sleep*.csv' under the data root; paths containing 'LabelingData' or '3.CognitiveFunction' are never opened
layout.manifest: manifest.csv with a single column 'sid' (steward-supplied, label-free); subjects not in the manifest are ignored, manifest sids without data are reported as 'no_data'

activity_day_start.assert: first 19 chars parse with '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'; zero NaT; hour == 4 for 100% of rows (04:00 local anchor)

activity_low.assert: no NaN for scoreable subjects; NaN -> subject refused (feature_unavailable)

activity_non_wear.role: QC only (known to miss MET==0.0 no-data days); never a model input

activity_total.role: tie-break key for duplicate (sid,date) activity rows

CONVERT(activity_met_1min USING utf8).format: 1440 '/'-separated decimal values with exactly one trailing '/'
CONVERT(activity_met_1min USING utf8).assert: after removing one trailing '/', split gives exactly 1440 finite tokens; 0 <= MET <= 25
CONVERT(activity_met_1min USING utf8).role: QC only for B0 (coverage, sentinel runs); B0 features use activity_low

join_and_window.sleep_dedup: per (sid, date) keep the row with the largest sleep_duration; tie -> earliest sleep_bedtime_start
join_and_window.activity_dedup: per (sid, date) keep the row with the earliest activity_day_start then largest activity_total (verified identical to the AI-Hub keep-first rule, CT9b)
join_and_window.window: first 35 joined rows per subject after sorting by (sid, date); calendar gaps allowed and reported as gap_days = span - 35

refusal_codes.schema_fail: any assert above failed for this subject

qc_report_only.met_coverage: share of minutes with MET >= 0.5 per day; reference median 0.999, p1 0.811
qc_report_only.zero_run_gt_60: days with a MET == 0.0 run longer than 60 min; reference 24/12150
qc_report_only.psi_vs_reference: PSI and KS of low_SD, low_MED, nonwear_mean, gap_days vs the 174 reference quantiles in b0_frozen_v1.json; flag PSI > 0.25 as domain shift; scores are never altered

forbidden_inputs: any column whose name matches the FEATURE_GUARD pattern (mmse, q\d+, diag, doctor, email-as-feature, non_wear-as-feature, n_days, span, coverage, gap_, missfrac, valid_days) or the covariate block list (age, sex, gender, edu, education, gait, moca, cdr, label) is never read into a feature matrix by the sealed scorer
